mechanism: Mebendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing metoprolol metabolism via CYP2D6, with minimal clinical significance due to metoprolol's wide therapeutic index.
action: No dose adjustment typically required; monitor for excessive beta-blockade effects (bradycardia, hypotension) if using high-dose mebendazole, though clinically significant interaction is unlikely.
